title: eleocharis acutangula
intro: Eleocharis acutangula, commonly known as Spike-rush or Needle Spike-rush, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Eleocharis acutangula include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating effects, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Eleocharis acutangula include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which have been shown to possess antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
